groupings.title: Start here
groupings.description: Trace a behavior, cover a regression, or simplify code. Use one skill for the task in front of you; no new workflow or ao CLI is required.

groupings.title: Build and review
groupings.description: Clarify a change, implement it, and check the result. Choose these independently; Validate requires the ao CLI.

groupings.title: Explore and learn
groupings.description: Compare ideas and retrieve relevant context when it can help the current task.

groupings.title: Deliberate workflows
groupings.description: Select a review strategy, the RPI charter, goal planning, or skill authoring and evaluation when the task calls for it.

groupings.title: Optional tool adapters
groupings.description: Use these only with the corresponding runtime or tool. They are not prerequisites for the starter skills.
